body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 58 (2026-10-17 17:36Z) compacts rev 57 for host 7a5ab65e (TermAl 459f8540).

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL paged output (read until complete:true). Parent-scoped results can't be read by the coordinator; rely on the parent's full read.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task or a subagent; TermAl restricts the session's test credit until it ends. A foreground command past 600 s, or a chained sleep, is moved to the background or blocked, so keep store checks short (never `engram doctor` on a live store from the foreground tool). Launch credited runs through the BASH tool. CODEX lanes run launcher commands through their NATIVE exec (the Bash rule is Claude-only).

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run every check worth keeping through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full). Results persist in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json even if the turn ends. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its exit and output (TermAl w-8f7e2d914724).
- Credited forms: a launcher run, or a bare test command alone in the foreground from the item's named root. Any of | & ; < > $( makes it uncredited. Credit binds to the turn's FOCUSED claim: a run in a turn focused on another item gets no credit there. Never rerun only for credit.
- Nothing wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac). After a lane ends a turn awaiting a focused run or a "next turn" step, the coordinator wakes it; the watchdog checks results.json for finished runs.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends while the turn that started it is open (w-67d248c998ef).

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at the MAIN checkout; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root {work, path} (never `root`); it takes effect next turn. Supported clear: {work} with NO path, from a live claim.
- The 64-slot table (shared by both projects) fills up: own-clear an item's root after its evaluation passes and BEFORE done. Completed items' roots free only via TermAl's audited release (w-52222, in review). On a naming 502 (w-c2ad725f3ba8), retry the IDENTICAL request once.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason) and roots may need re-naming.

DETACHED GATES
- From a mediated turn in the named root: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` (never self). START to Fable2 before LAUNCH NOW. Gate and review pair run IN PARALLEL on the same freeze, and a failed gate discards that round's reviews.
- While a gate is carried: no shell naming its worktree from any session, no edits, keep focus. NEVER cd into a lane's worktree (use git -C). No supported cancel for a detached gate: never kill one.
- Check `df -B1G /c` before gates. A full disk fails Cargo with "no space on device" or LNK1180; delete idle worktrees' target/debug and release, and a landed worktree's build output.

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): after termal_evaluate_acceptance, make NO tracker write in that turn and hold it with termal_wait_delegations. On a genuine fix round, reuse the settled evaluator (reuseDelegationId; at most 3 attempts). Brief clipping (w-94f5dee40694): one compact holder note per criterion, at most 3.5 KB.

APPROVALS AND QUEUES
- All Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE (P0 w-fa936228028f live). A lane in status "approval" or waiting for a human is PARKED: tell Fable2 at once. No manual approval clicks (Greg).
- STUCK HEADS (w-7635e5349aab): when an Engram control call returns control_store_busy or deadline_exceeded, TermAl may park the head as "Waiting/Unknown after interrupted authorization" with queuePaused=true. A wake then returns durableButNotWoken. Check `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/sessions/session-ID` and ask Fable2 to cancel the head and resume the queue. Bounded retry: w-ac230a24d0d8 (Greg contract: 20 s per attempt, a 240 s budget per head).
- A resumed turn may replay the OLD plan (w-e4c65f30c77b): send a superseding message first.
- control_request_expired (held Engram w-0b69) needs TermAl w-339b57a1d89d live before Engram installs it.

HOST TIMESTAMPS: stamp_now() is local "HH:MM:SS". For timing, subscribe read-only to GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/events (SSE). Fix: w-c6910333fdb9 (P2).

OTHER: Codex "blocked by policy" refusals (w-e2a5af1634f0): plain single commands, never bypass. Reviewer briefs are multi-line, first line "read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md". Never run TERMAL_CLI without a known subcommand (w-e5151bf4da18). A worktree removal blocked by a live cwd: leave the folder and never kill. The watchdog cron (Engram::Fable session) lives only in the session; re-create it after a restart or compaction.

REV 59 (2026-10-17 19:33Z, Engram::Fable), from w-95481455ce36's closure: OWN-CLEAR BEFORE DONE IS NOT SAFE UNCONDITIONALLY.
- After a landing, the post-evaluation build, install and landing observations make the holder's evaluation STALE ("mutation"), so done needs a fresh evaluation.
- If the named root was already own-cleared, the refresh evaluator gets bound to the MAIN checkout. That evaluation fails 409 source_changed if main moves mid-run (the coordinator's main fast-forward did this).
- A root re-named after the clear needs a checkpointed next turn before an evaluator request is admitted (409 "no Engram sighting").
- Clearing again after a fresh PASS can stale it again.
WORKING ORDER:
1. Land.
2. Get the fresh closure evaluation.
3. Done, with no tracker write or clear in between.
4. Own-clear LAST, only if done doesn't need the root.
The coordinator does NOT fast-forward the main checkout while a lane's closure evaluation may read main: fast-forward main only after the lane reports done.
Reported to Fable2 (#2702; 8581's fix request #538).

REV 60 (2026-10-17 22:22Z, Engram::Fable): TermAl P1 w-b576a44fb793. A gate that a CLAUDE lane launches as a Bash-BACKGROUND task fences itself, and the host refuses its credit even when it passes (TermAl w-d9f9 had to re-gate). Claude lanes launch gates ONLY as a foreground `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` from the named root, never with run_in_background. Retire this line when w-b576 is fixed and live.
